name: Schlichte Steinhager
production: Triple distilled from neutral wheat spirit and juniper berries (per reviewer)
nose: Very faint, subtle hint of gin
notes: Only source is a consumer review (The Gin is In), which names the producer as 'Steinhager Genever Distillery' and says the recipe dates to the 15th century. Bottled in a distinctive earthenware (stone) bottle. Reviewer suggests Gimlet, Negroni, or sweeter tonics. ABV, Schwarze & Schlichte ownership and 1766 date not confirmed [cần kiểm tra].
